carried_steady.reason: best steady-state hold; 20 s 0.274 m, 60 s 0.326 m, 120 s 0.361 m; retains double-ki and double-kv_vy margins, loses double-kv_vx and double-ky

carried_transition.reason: wider walk->hold settle window (0.75-1.25 s) than the combined config; used for C3h

policy.switch_threshold: external command decides the schedule; loop ON only in hold segments (|vx_cmd|<0.05, |vy_cmd|<0.05, |wz_cmd|<0.05). Same gains in walk and hold; no policy swap, no integrator carry across engage (reset on engage).

H3.note: identical to H1: policy owns the arms

policy.tuned_note: settle window is 0.75-1.25 s and 2.0 s; 0.5 s and 1.5 s fall; H2 x3 survives with a 1.0 s settle but heading drifts ~7.5 deg/cycle

summary.label: C3h H1 combined gains, no settle

soft.switch_threshold: external command decides the schedule; loop ON only in hold segments (|vx_cmd|<0.05, |vy_cmd|<0.05, |wz_cmd|<0.05). Same gains in walk and hold; no policy swap, no integrator carry across engage (reset on engage).

H3.note: independent arm controller; reach ramps 1-3 s
